correctness.rationale: Finite irreducible noisy spin chain: pair expectations close on two permutation orbits and satisfy two exact stationary generator identities with positive denominator. The part-magnetization difference is an exact generator eigenfunction; therefore the two-time covariance follows by the semigroup identity, and the susceptibility by convergent exponential integration. Exact substitutions give two and three-or-more part weak-noise limits. Standalone script passed 62 finite-state checks and three sympy identities; examples supplement rather than replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The response observable is motivated by physical antiferromagnetic sublattice contrast. Two parts allow an opposed slow mode, whereas triangles in any three-or-more-part graph frustrate this mode. The result shows a nontrivial finite-size all-parameter dynamical identity and a quantitative factor-n-squared separation in integrated susceptibilities in the same weak-refresh scaling window. This is not a known-table recomputation or arbitrary finite example.
